name: team_planning_set_planned_level
description: Plan a promotion in a scenario of a Team Planning plan: the level a person holds from this step on. The plan keeps the level private to that person, so once they are forgotten it reads as removed. A planned level wins over a level corrected with team_planning_set_plan_value. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as why this person moves. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. Deleting the plan erases it.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

level.description: The level, as the Org Graph names levels.
